title: Check Dependencies — checkDeps
text: Check package requirements specified given DESCRIPTION met.

title: Check Dependencies — checkDeps
text: descriptionFile Path DESCRIPTION file path belongs source package project. /DEPENDENCIES exists used instead. dependencyTypes types dependencies check. Must subset c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo", "Suggests", "Enhances"). action Action take unmet dependencies: "stop": Issue error unmet dependencies. (Default.) "warn": Issue warning unmet dependencies. "note": Issue message unmet dependencies. "pass": nothing, just return invisibly. "ask": Ask user whether auto-fix missing dependencies. Requires active renv. also write renv.lock. active renv found, stops instead.
